_convention: A node with no _status is assignable. _status:'not-assignable' means the class is real on the ground but cannot be assigned with current methodology; it must carry _why and _unlock. Pick-list surfaces (the review page's class inputs) MUST filter these out; the glossary and coverage analyses MUST NOT. Note the reader agent now reads the glossary directly, so filtering alone no longer keeps a blocked class away from a reader -- see class-definitions.md.

natural_forest._why: Essentially absent in this AOI - everything wooded around Auroville was planted within living memory. Previously 'retired' in prose only, while remaining pickable here; 0 uses in 266 verdicts.
natural_forest._unlock: Evidence of a genuinely self-regenerating stand with no planting history

planted_forest._description: Managed woody planting - trees established and tended by people, whatever the origin or purpose: forestry, ecological restoration, or amenity. Auroville's TDEF restoration blocks and its non-native plantings both land here. Species mix is not a criterion and neither is commercial intent.

tree_lines._description: Linear woody features outside forest blocks - roadside/avenue tree strips, canal and bund alignments, riparian green strips. Width <= 30 m, length >= 30 m (Copernicus Small Woody Features geometry; FSI Trees-Outside-Forests 'linear' stratum).

scattered_trees._description: FSI Trees-Outside-Forests 'scattered' stratum - individual trees on farmland, homesteads and community land, not forming a block or a line. Palmyra (Borassus flabellifer) standing on field edges and bunds is the characteristic local case; tamarind and isolated farm trees are others.
scattered_trees._note: This closes a half-import: the crosswalk cites FSI TOF's block/linear/scattered strata but only ever instantiated 'linear' (as tree_lines). 'block' needs no node - it is already covered by planted_forest and orchards.casuarina (verified: 6 woodlot/block-plantation mentions, all correctly homed).

protected_cultivation._description: Engineered growing structures - shade-net houses, polyhouses, nursery beds under cloth. FAO LCCS protected/greenhouse cultivation; CORINE permanent greenhouse cover.

agroforestry._why: All four nodes: 0 uses in 266 verdicts. The definitions require TWO production layers visible at once, but at 0.58 m/px nadir the understorey is under the canopy - the crop layer cannot be seen through the trees. Candidates fall through to planted_forest. This is a sensor limit, not an absence: agroforestry is a defining Auroville land use.
agroforestry._unlock: Oblique or ground imagery, or a definition rewritten around canopy-structure cues that ARE visible from nadir

sparse_built._description: Low density buildings in open areas

bare_ground._description: Flat, smooth, undissected bare laterite - no channel dissection, no extraction, no construction activity. NRSC Level II 'Barren rocky'; NRSC wasteland stratum 'barren rocky / stony waste / sheet rock'.

compacted_corridor._description: Anthropogenic bare surfaces - track corridors, graded embankments, cleared service strips. Bare through traffic and grading rather than erosion; a surface, not a made road.

thorny_scrub._why: 0 uses and never once offered as an alternative, while sparse_scrub grew fastest at the lowest confidence of any major class (0.40). Prosopis juliflora is the dominant invasive on degraded land across Tamil Nadu and is very likely present, but it is not separable from native thorn scrub (Acacia planifrons, Ziziphus, Carissa) at 0.58 m/px nadir - same texture, same tone, same niche. Zero mentions across 482 texts is therefore unexplained, not reassuring.
thorny_scrub._unlock: z19 imagery (now available) or field survey confirming Prosopis presence and appearance

grazing_land._why: Retired earlier as a catch-all that absorbed any smooth open ground. Previously 'retired' in prose only while remaining pickable here - two verdicts still carry it.
grazing_land._unlock: Positive grazing evidence (stock, tracks, enclosure) distinguishable from mown or fallow ground
